subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept openai/codex-action v1.11’s privileged hosted-Linux sandbox preparation in the secret-capable docs, maturity, and performance agent workflows as part of this grouped update?
rationale: The code is upstream executable infrastructure: CI can detect failures, but it cannot decide whether enabling user namespaces and tearing down AppArmor restrictions before dropping sudo matches OpenClaw’s intended workflow security boundary.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Refresh the branch, require final-head workflow evidence, and have a CI/security owner approve the upstream sandbox behavior before merge.

options.title: Split the Codex action update
options.body: Land the routine action pins separately and hold the Codex action revision for an isolated security-boundary review.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Wait for Dependabot repository access and a clean regenerated branch before reviewing any executable revision changes.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, require final-head workflow evidence, and have a CI/security owner approve the upstream sandbox behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest involvement across the affected CI and agent-workflow surfaces.
